sql: WITH a AS(SELECT "issue_id","issue_key","age_risk_score","assignee_name","assignment_risk_score","collaboration_opportunity_score","completion_probability","complexity_risk_score","current_priority","current_status","deviation_risk_score","efficiency_opportunity_score","health_status","high_complexity_risk","intelligence_score","intervention_urgency","is_active_sprint","issue_type","lifecycle_outlier_status","lifecycle_pattern","lifecycle_quality_score","predicted_completion_timeframe","process_opportunity_score","project_name","recommended_action","regression_ratio","strategic_importance","total_opportunity_score","total_risk_score",count(*) n FROM replay.marts.jira__issue_intelligence_analytics GROUP BY ALL),g AS(SELECT "issue_id","issue_key","age_risk_score","assignee_name","assignment_risk_score","collaboration_opportunity_score","completion_probability","complexity_risk_score","current_priority","current_status","deviation_risk_score","efficiency_opportunity_score","health_status","high_complexity_risk","intelligence_score","intervention_urgency","is_active_sprint","issue_type","lifecycle_outlier_status","lifecycle_pattern","lifecycle_quality_score","predicted_completion_timeframe","process_opportunity_score","project_name","recommended_action","regression_ratio","strategic_importance","total_opportunity_score","total_risk_score",count(*) n FROM gold.marts.jira__issue_intelligence_analytics GROUP BY ALL) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM a EXCEPT ALL SELECT * FROM g)),(SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM g EXCEPT ALL SELECT * FROM a))
meaning: 排除两个运行时派生列后，带重复次数的整行分组多重集差异；0/0才证明其余列与多重性完全一致。

sql: SELECT min(i.created_at+g.total_lifecycle_days*interval '1 day')::VARCHAR,max(i.created_at+g.total_lifecycle_days*interval '1 day')::VARCHAR FROM gold.marts.jira__issue_intelligence_analytics g JOIN gold.marts.jira__issue_enhanced i USING(issue_id) WHERE i.resolved_at IS NULL
